substitutions: Synthetic metadata with explicit creation dates in both original input slots.
Original projector, helpers, protobuf defaults and metadata decoration policy execute unchanged. No app, React, account, HTTP or DOM runs.
limits: The ordinary playlist projector and policy omit creation time in this build; this is not a claim about every Spotify version or surface.
The actual native Playlist4 field is separate and reaches the client; playlist-creation.json proves its original field binding.
